comments.body: 2026-11-11: on main (2fd7f8f1), daemon protocol minor 15. An agent's group delete, pause and resume of a group kept elsewhere are carried to its home and done there as that agent under the home's policy. group set, add and remove are still refused, and the refusal names the command to run on that machine. Not yet run between a laptop and a devenv.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-09 on 0.24.0, from a pane on the laptop, while clearing out @human groups whose agents had gone; six of them were kept on the devenv. `muster msg group delete @human+almond@devenv` refused: "@human+almond@devenv is kept on devenv, so its members, policy and pause are changed there, with `muster msg` on devenv; this machine only holds a copy". On the devenv, `muster` is on PATH only inside a pane, so running it there from outside meant finding the newest `~/.muster/daemon/<version>/muster` by hand among older version directories and running `msg group delete --no-window @human+almond` with it.

The window lists these groups as the person's own, and a post already reaches the other machine by `--to <name>@devenv`, so the refusal is what stops someone at the window's machine from tidying their own list. a_2cU50cXtT added closing a group from the sidebar, routed to the daemon that keeps it; the CLI still refuses (`Refusal::KeptElsewhere` in crates/muster-daemon/src/messages/mod.rs).

Possibly: forward `group delete`, and the other verbs that refusal covers, to the machine that keeps the group, as a post is forwarded. Failing that, name the exact command to run on that machine in the refusal.
title: A group kept on another machine cannot be deleted from the window's machine
